text: Which of the following figures correctly represent the shape of curve of binding energy per nucleon as a function of mass number ?

options.label: A
options.text: a plot of \(\frac{\mathrm{B.E.}}{\mathrm{A}}\) against A that rises steeply from a low value, reaches a broad flat maximum just past the dashed vertical line marked 56, and then falls away slowly

options.label: B
options.text: a plot of \(\frac{\mathrm{B.E.}}{\mathrm{A}}\) against A that rises steeply and levels off at the dashed vertical line marked 56, remaining almost flat for the whole of the rest of the range

options.label: C
options.text: a plot of \(\frac{\mathrm{B.E.}}{\mathrm{A}}\) against A that begins low and flat, rises to an almost symmetric hump peaking at the dashed vertical line marked 80, and then falls back to a low flat value

options.label: D
options.text: a plot of \(\frac{\mathrm{B.E.}}{\mathrm{A}}\) against A that rises steeply to a peak at the dashed vertical line marked 80, falls to a shallow minimum and then turns upward again at the far right
